title: Herbaceous Noodle Soup
description: A light and refreshing soup perfect for any occasion. This herbaceous noodle soup combines the delicate flavors of puffed noodles with the earthy taste of oozy goodness.
instructions: In a large pot, bring the vegetable broth to a simmer.
Add the puffed noodles to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes or until they are tender.
Add the oozy and herbaceous to the pot and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional herbaceous if desired.
